extracted.intended_audience: health journalists, health communicators, consumers interested in evaluating health news, and potential donors
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and high-level mission for evaluating health care journalism, advertising, marketing, public relations and other consumer-facing health messages, emphasizing informed/shared decision-making and editorial independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve public dialogue by helping consumers critically analyze claims
rubrics_metrics.description: The mission of HealthNewsReview.org is to improve the public dialogue about health care by helping consumers critically analyze claims about health care interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the site's core purpose and frames its evaluative work; reviews and resources are aimed at increasing consumer ability to assess health-related claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote shared decision-making with accurate, balanced, complete information
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting the principles of shared decision-making reinforced by accurate, balanced and complete information about the tradeoffs involved in health care decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes that coverage should present benefits, harms, and tradeoffs clearly so consumers and clinicians can make informed choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of evaluation: journalism, advertising, marketing, PR and other messages
rubrics_metrics.description: HealthNewsReview.org evaluates health care journalism, advertising, marketing, public relations and other messages that may influence consumers and provides criteria that consumers can use to evaluate these messages themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site's reviews and toolkits apply across multiple message types (news stories, ads, PR) and aim to equip consumers with evaluative criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial independence from funders
rubrics_metrics.description: No funder has ever had, nor will they ever have, any editorial control over the operation of the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site discloses its funders (e.g., Laura and John Arnold Foundation grant, past Informed Medical Decisions Foundation support) and states that funding does not affect editorial decisions; donations are accepted but editorial independence is asserted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about funding and donations
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on how HealthNewsReview.org is funded and clear acknowledgment of grants and past funders; a GIVE NOW button allows donations to support operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site names major funders and thanks donors; while accepting donations, it reiterates that funders have no editorial control—this transparency is part of its standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy of subscriber information
rubrics_metrics.description: We will not display your name or e-mail address on the site, nor will we share your e-mail address with any third parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to their e-mail digest/subscription service—contact information is kept private and not publicly posted or shared.
